snippet.title: Break The Night - Teaser
snippet.description:
https://breakthenight.com/

A colorful Action Hack 'N' Slash game about magical girls and deteriorating dreamscapes.

Play as Mel, Marten and Mika traversing liminal spaces via a network of trains. With the help of magical critters and a bizarre cast of characters, follow the trio as they face nightmares beyond comprehension while desperately clinging to their sanity.

Play the prototype at SAGE 2026: https://sonicfangameshq.com/forums/showcase/break-the-night-sage-prototype.3226/
